text: レッドは　ファミコンを　してる！
note: The Famicom (short for Family Computer) is Nintendo's 1983 home console, the Japanese original of the machine sold abroad as the NES, which is why the English game says NES.
claim: The Famicom (Family Computer) is Nintendo's home console released in Japan in 1983 and sold abroad as the Nintendo Entertainment System (NES).

check.quote: It was released as the Family Computer (Famicom) in Japan on July 15, 1983, and as the NES in test markets in the United States on October 18, 1985, followed by a nationwide launch on September 27, 1986.
